description:
Adds a "ReVanced" settings screen at the top of rif's settings with a section per patch:
- Disable ads: Block ads toggle (default on)
- Inline comment images: Inline images + Scale inline images to fit (default on; off = native size)

Manager URL (raw): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MojiRS/revanced-rif-patches/main/patches.rvp
